description: This Java class 'TimerSchedulerMemento' extends 'OpenmrsMemento' and manages the state related to timer scheduler tasks, including tracking started task IDs and error task IDs, with functionality to add, remove, and retrieve error tasks, as well as save error task states into the current state.

classes.name: TimerSchedulerMemento
classes.description: A class for capturing and restoring the state of scheduler timer tasks, including tracking error and started task IDs.

methods.name: TimerSchedulerMemento
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the memento with a set of started task IDs.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state, which is the set of started task IDs.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the state to a given object presumed to be a set of task IDs.

methods.name: addErrorTask
methods.description: Adds a task ID to the set of error tasks.

methods.name: removeErrorTask
methods.description: Removes a task ID from the set of error tasks.

methods.name: getErrorTasks
methods.description: Returns the static set of error task IDs.

methods.name: saveErrorTasks
methods.description: Merges error task IDs into the current set of started task IDs.
